content:
Belkin has a beefy new 25W MagSafe battery on the market – packing a whopping 10,000mAh of capacity. It has two killer new features: a kickstand, and a second MagSafe ring. Initially unveiled back at CES 2026, it’s now available for purchase.

Despite having 10,000mAh of capacity – the Belkin UltraCharge Pro MagSafe battery isn’t incredibly bulky. It isn’t slim by any means, but I’d say it’s around double the thickness of an iPhone in a case. It’s not light, but it’s by no means unbearable if you want the juice. It features a mixed plastic-silicone finish, with the iPhone-facing side being silicone, and the outward-facing side being a hard plastic.

On the back, you’ll find two standout features: a second MagSafe ring, and a kickstand.

The second MagSafe ring is an excellent feature. If you find yourself using a MagSafe wallet, popsocket, or other accessory you still want to keep on your iPhone, you can do that whilst charging your iPhone still. Plus, theres a kickstand for propping up your phone to watch a video – similar to the Belkin 5K MagSafe battery I looked at last month.

On the side, you’ll find a little LED screen that displays your battery percentage. Of course, it supports 25W Qi2.2. It also supports 30W output for wired charging, just in case you need to charge another device that isn’t MagSafe.

The Belkin UltraCharge Pro comes in two colors: Black and Sand. It’s available on Amazon for $84.99, a 15% discount from its typical pricing.
